loan.company_info: Valos is a digital asset manager specialising in private credit strategies. We provide lending solutions designed for professional and institutional investors seeking disciplined access to credit opportunities in digital asset markets.
loan.label: CREDIT
loan.vault_strategy: AUSD deposited into the vault is lent to Valos. Valos manages a private credit portfolio, deploying capital to large, established institutions operating across the crypto industry. Borrowers include market makers, prime brokers, exchanges, and custodians. Vault deposits are backed by loan receivables owed to Valos by these institutions, providing secured exposure to institutional private credit.

deploymentEvidence.distinctProductBasis: Valos issuer launch identifies its institutional lending vault on Monad, accessible through Accountable YieldApp. Current API specifies borrower/investment manager and loans to Valos against its private-credit receivables. This is Valos own credit investor product; Accountable is the vault framework, not an already-admitted Morpho/Euler curator label.

abiEvidence.explorerPresentation: Exact Match heading alongside Similar Match badge linking 0xdefd210dc0bd4b249904de47947e837643de6578. Conservatively recorded as match, not exact_match.

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC4626 "Tokenized Vault Standard", as defined in
 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4626[ERC-4626].

interface IERC4626 is IERC20, IERC20Metadata {
    event Deposit(address indexed sender, address indexed owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares);

    event Withdraw(
        address indexed sender,
        address indexed receiver,
        address indexed owner,
        uint256 assets,
        uint256 shares
    );

     * @dev Returns the address of the underlying token used for the Vault for accounting, depositing, and withdrawing.

Valos owns the institutional private-credit investor product, not merely a curator label over a Morpho/Euler vault: the primary issuer launch links Accountable YieldApp and its current API binds the Valos loan to this vUSD root vault on Monad 143. Accountable supplies the technical vault framework. Only this root is admitted; third-party lending integrations are not.

Root AccountableAsyncRedeemVault is constructor-deployed, not a proxy/clone: immutable strategy is 0x8dce15fc6a98484c995fc702cbfbda14a30454af. MonadScan provides a similar-contract source/ABI match to 0xdefd210dc0bd4b249904de47947e837643de6578; the page also displays an Exact Match heading, so this evidence conservatively records match, not exact_match. The external strategy and its upgrade/runtime identities are dependencies not independently attested here.

AUSD assets and vUSD shares use 6 decimals; immutable price precision is 1e36, not a standard pool-balance exchange rate. Deposits floor shares and mints ceil assets using strategy hook prices. Redeem claims floor assets, and withdraw computes floor shares while using ceil quantities to reduce entitlement; small residuals may be exhausted. Root min amount is 10000 atoms, while strategy terms impose additional minima/capacity.

Current permissionLevel() is Whitelist (2), signer() is zero; selected methods use existing receiver/controller/owner whitelist membership, not appended KYC authorization signatures. Controller must be caller or an already-approved operator; requestRedeem also checks existing owner/operator rights. Plain deposits source controller funds via preexisting AUSD allowance. No onboarding, wallet signatures, permits, operator authorization, agreements, or whitelist management are added.

requestRedeem escrows owner shares and may instantly reserve claim liquidity (request ID 0) or queue them for strategy fulfillment. redeem/withdraw claim already-fulfilled controller entitlement, not ordinary instant exits. cancelRedeemRequest requires strategy approval and returns only pending escrowed shares to the eligible receiver; claimable portions are not cancelled. Timing, liquidity, cancellation and losses depend on the strategy/borrower; no queue servicing or principal guarantee.

Primary current API reports active/approved, can_deposit=true, paused=false and minimum investment 100000000000 AUSD atoms (100000 AUSD); these are point-in-time metadata, not wallet eligibility or availability guarantees. Loan fee manager reports performanceFee=30000 with denominator 1000000 (3%), managementFee=0 and establishmentFee=0; pricing/fees can change and hooks determine execution. Allocations fund Valos institutional private-credit receivables; borrower default, collateral shortfalls, offchain custody/enforcement, liquidity and jurisdictional restrictions can cause some or all principal loss.
